# lk3d 0.7.0, built

`lk3d.min.js` and `lk3d-live.min.js` as lk3d 0.7.0 (commit 4e1e4dd, released 23 November 2026) builds them, kept for the
version-skew tests in `test/visual/api.spec.mjs`: the 0.7.0 live add-on on this core, and a newer add-on on the 0.7.0
core. Made with `git archive 4e1e4dd packages/lk3d`, then `node build.mjs` there. Never edited by hand.
